international.title: Haigh tells CBI that even US which is ‘hardly a hotbed of socialism’ has more public control of utilities than UK – UK politics live
international.summary: First secretary of state gives further detail on Burnham’s plans and says the government is not against the markets In her speech, Louise Haigh announced that Juergen Maier, chair of Great British Energy, has been appointed as the government’s northern economy and reindustrialisation commissioner. She said: Giving business the confidence to invest here, and create good jobs in our industrial heartlands. Creating good quality jobs in all parts of the country. The role of the private sector is essential to fulfilling that. That is why I am delighted to announce today a new northern economy and reindustrialisation commissioner. With an impeccable industrial career we can learn much from, welcome, Juergen Maier. Continue reading...
